title.zh: 增加东内格罗斯省Guihulngan急诊医院床位并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Guihulngan Emergency Hospital in the Province of Negros Oriental, and Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Guihulngan Emergency Hospital in the Province of Negros Oriental, and Authorizing the Appropriations of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Cấp cứu Guihulngan tại Tỉnh Negros Oriental, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน Guihulngan ในจังหวัด Negros Oriental และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat Guihulngan di Provinsi Negros Oriental, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Kecemasan Guihulngan di Wilayah Negros Oriental, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_4102_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of Guihulngan Emergency Hospital is hereby increased from twenty-five to fifty.

The financing of this hospital shall be in accordance with the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred thirty-nine, otherwise known as the Hospital Financing Act. The necessary sums for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1964.
